_comment: PGC1 M1 cross-stack gameId vectors (ANT-490, parent ANT-485 spec §3.1/§3.5). Derivation: gameId = keccak256(abi.encode(string chainId, bytes publisher, string localId)). Consumed by BOTH chains/evm/test/M1Schema.ts (ethers/viem abi.encode + keccak) and the Solana registry unit tests (manual §3.1 byte layout + keccak) to prove cross-stack equivalence (AC-GAMEID-1..3).
_deviation: Vectors 1-3 reproduce the spec §3.1 worked examples byte-identically (verified with viem encodeAbiParameters). Vectors 4-5 as PRINTED in the spec do not reproduce under the normative derivation: #5's publisher hex is 66 chars (33 bytes, spec labels it 32 B), and #4's chainId is truncated with an ellipsis so the exact preimage is unrecoverable. Both are recomputed here from the stated inputs with corrected 32-byte publishers (see publisherNote). Flagged to Theo (spec owner) for confirmation; cross-stack equivalence (the normative property, AC-GAMEID-2) holds for all 5 as written.

vectors.publisherNote: Publisher hex as printed (64 chars / 32 B, clean). Spec prints chainId truncated (solana:EtWBMkg…Au34) and gameId 0xdac0…4208, which does not reproduce from the §3.1 normative table's full devnet string under abi.encode(string,bytes,string); recomputed here from the full normative chainId.

Spec prints 66 hex chars (33 bytes) while labeling it (32 B). Corrected to 32 bytes by dropping the trailing 00 of the repeated 0011…eeff pattern; spec gameId 0x1669…1756 does not reproduce from any 32-byte variant, so gameId is recomputed.
